ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution with a contrast ratio of approximately 95% dark to 5% light localized pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-intensity speckles located primarily on the medial and distal regions of the right lobe and central peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel amplitudes (2-8 pixels) observed across the entire trailing edge boundary, most pronounced on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white pixels located mid-surface on the right lobe and near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular cluster of raised, high-contrast pixel formations (barnacle colonization) localized at the distal tip of the right fluke lobe.
